words.definition: to go up and down; to change
examples: No one is very comfortable making a large investment while currency values fluctuate.
Prime business areas fluctuate with local economies, crime rates, and cost of living indices.
The agent wasn't sure if the executives could get out of their prior real estate arrangement.
The company wanted to get out of the area before property values declined further.
If the economy is an accurate indicator, rental prices will increase rapidly.
The results of the elections were seen as an important indicator of stability.

words.definition: a contract to pay to use property; to make a contract to use property
words.vietnamese_meaning: hợp đồng cho thuê, thuê lại
examples: With the lease expiring next year, they need to start looking for a new location.
They decided to lease the property rather than buy it.

words.definition: to commit; to be unable to change
words.vietnamese_meaning: ràng buộc, cam kết cố định
examples: The company locked itself into a ten-year lease that they didn't want.
Before you lock yourself into something, check all your options.
Tenants are usually allowed to occupy their space beginning on the first day of the month.
Our company has occupied this office for more than five years.
You could arrange the lease with an option to buy after a certain amount of time.
With the real estate market so tight right now, you don't have that many options.
This contract is subject to all the laws and regulations of the state.
The go-ahead to buy is subject to the president's approval.
